findings.claim: The validator prompt replaces the blocking `make build && make vet` gate with `go build ./... && go vet ./...`, so agents following this manifest will not execute the required project constraint.
findings.evidence: Constraint `build-passes` requires command `make build && make vet`, but the added validator command table says: `go build ./... && go vet ./...` and describes it as equivalent to the `build-passes` constraint.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the validator require `make build && make vet` exactly, or run it in a temporary/clean worktree and ignore/remove the generated `./fhir-server` afterward while still preserving the constraint command.
